question: What conduct should a practitioner with an even mind abandon through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind
Village duty is named as something to be given up
The verse gives a prescriptive instruction
inference: Through practice, one with an even mind should abandon village duty
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to conventional social or household duties
plain_english: Through practice, with an even mind, one should abandon the duties of village life.
